response.rationale: The item is apparel, not final sale, and not defective (customer confirms nothing is wrong). At 53 days since delivery, it falls outside the 30-day standard return window. RET-008 applies (days_since_delivery > 30 and final_sale == False), making the return ineligible. No higher-priority rule applies: not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051).
